map.输入原始分数、总体均值与总体标准差，将分数标准化为 Z 分数 (x−μ)/σ，并: Enter the raw score, population mean, and population standard deviation to standardize the score into a Z-score (x−μ)/σ and give the corresponding percentile rank; Z>0 means above the mean, Z<0 below, easing cross-distribution comparison.
map.Z = (x − μ) / σ；百分位 = Φ(Z) × 100%；距均值 =: Z = (x − μ) / σ; percentile = Φ(Z) × 100%; distance from mean = |Z| standard deviations
map.Z 分数把原始分数 x 按其分布标准化：减去均值 μ 再除以标准差 σ，得到相对: The Z-score standardizes the raw score x by its distribution: subtract the mean μ and divide by the standard deviation σ to get the number of standard deviations from the mean. Then use the standard normal CDF Φ(Z) to convert to a percentile rank (the share of data below it). Z > 0 is above the mean, Z < 0 below, easing cross-distribution comparison.
